evidence_slice: University of Exeter Digital Estate Team public ArcGIS Roof Access Safety Web App item metadata. The item states that the dashboard covers University of Exeter rooftops on the Exeter campuses, provides detailed building-specific roof data across both Streatham and St Luke's campuses, and uses British National Grid. The selected item-metadata window does not expose an underlying feature record, feature-layer URL, or Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates for the Medical School building at St Luke's, so the physical-footprint criterion cannot be verified from this window.

field_evidence.footprint: Official app metadata confirms building-specific University rooftop GIS coverage in British National Grid, but this selected item-metadata window exposes no record-level Medical School Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates or feature payload.
field_evidence.location: Official app metadata explicitly covers both Streatham and St Luke's campuses in Exeter.
field_evidence.type_use: The target remains the Medical School building at St Luke's from the immediately prior verified official University source; this ArcGIS metadata window itself does not expose a record-bound Medical School feature.
